package_build.system_dependencies: Installed and updated by the distribution package manager

limitations: Other user compute work was using the GPU at 100%; it was left running. These are current-session measurements, not a controlled upstream speedup comparison.
No compilation or packaging ran during sampling.
The CachyOS package was measured on the Omarchy/Arch host, not on CachyOS itself.
CPU: percent of one logical core. Memory: process-tree PSS, not GPU VRAM.
Private GPU-backed Wayland session; fake Plus; no physical USB/LCD measurement; no interaction latency measurement.
frontend: egui / eframe / wgpu Vulkan; GTK restoration has not shipped
documentation_edits: README status text was edited during the static trials; measured binary, runtime sources and fixtures were unchanged. Both runners recorded a clean tree at startup.
